# `mbx cache comparison-state`

- **Usage:** `mbx cache comparison-state [--json] [--verify] <FILE>`

Write an empty owner comparison baseline for a cold cache miss.

## Arguments
- **`<FILE>`** — Owner comparison-state file to write.

## Flags
- **`--json`** — Print a stable machine-readable report.
- **`--verify`** — Validate an existing owner baseline instead of writing an empty one.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
